title: Choose the dashboard composition
question: Pick the first-view structure to build, or tell me what to combine.

options.label: Balanced Overview
options.thesis: Attention, posture, performance, capital, costs, and evidence receive balanced first-view weight.
options.viewport: Two balanced upper columns lead into performance, capital, costs, and evidence panels.
options.risk: Balanced coverage can make the Principal decide what matters most instead of the interface deciding.

options.label: Attention First
options.lineage: Linear inbox hierarchy plus institutional risk operations
options.thesis: What needs the Principal appears first, with the system posture beside it and everything else immediately below.
options.viewport: A dominant attention workspace explains severity, consequence, due state, and evidence before the compact overview band.
options.risk: On quiet days, the dashboard may feel more issue-driven than performance-driven.

options.label: Heads-Up Matrix
options.lineage: executive risk matrix with Linear-level restraint
options.thesis: Four explicit answers dominate the first scan, then performance and attention deepen below them.
options.viewport: Safe and trusted, needs attention, after-cost performance, and capital and cost form the first row of answers.
options.risk: The large answer columns consume space and require disciplined copy as more states are added.
